D2 — Magnitude of the XZZ coefficient: reconstruction, paper eq. (40), and paper eq. (41) give three mutually inconsistent values for |g_ZZ| (factor-of-2 discrepancy), severity substantive.
D3 — Missing X-Z-h and X-gamma-h vertices: paper's eq. (48)/eq. (15) carries Higgs-doublet terms the reconstruction omits entirely, severity substantive (small in rate).
D4 — Non-abelian part of F_W dropped: reconstruction keeps only the abelian W field strength, so quartic vertices X W+ W- Z and X W+ W- gamma implied by the paper's eq. (48) are missing, severity substantive.
note: Since this is a control file with no injected defect, the reviewer correctly reports the reconstruction as matching the model; the substantive items it raises are inconsistencies inside the paper itself (the XZZ normalisation and sign) or deliberate unitary-gauge omissions, and it labels them as open questions for a human rather than as reconstruction errors, which would send a physicist to the right place.
